financings_after_balance_sheet.what: ATM sales under Open Market Sale Agreement, July 1 to Aug 1, 2024
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: From July 1, 2024 through August 1, 2024, the Company has sold approximately 544,295 shares of its common stock pursuant to the Open Market Sale Agreement for which the Company received net proceeds of approximately $28.8 million.

warrants.quote: The CFF Warrant is currently exercisable for 33,334 shares of the Company’s common stock and expires on January 26, 2025.
The K2 Warrant is immediately exercisable for 2,873 shares and expires on July 28, 2030.
